```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

options(bdat602.source_only = TRUE)
source("courses/bdat-602/_teacher/resources/datasets/simulate_bdat602_data.R")
health_data <- simulate_bdat602(n = 500000, seed = 602)
```

## Task 3: Full preprocessing pipeline

```{r task3-split}
set.seed(602)
split <- initial_split(health_data, prop = 0.80, strata = churned)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)
```

## Task 4: Verify the baked dataset

```{r task4-check-missing}
# TODO: confirm zero missing values in train_baked
total_missing <- sum(is.na(train_baked))
cat("Missing values in baked training set:", total_missing, "\n")
```

```{r task4-check-scale}
# TODO: compute mean and sd of age and income in train_baked
# They should both be approximately 0 and 1 respectively
train_baked |>
  summarise(
    age_mean   = mean(age),
    age_sd     = sd(age),
    income_mean = mean(income),
    income_sd   = sd(income)
  )
```

